summary: Tested Stripe payment integration end-to-end (backend + frontend). All 3 payment endpoints work correctly (7/7 pytest cases passed). Frontend Crown button opens modal, email input + checkout button correctly redirect to Stripe checkout (cs_test_... session created), restore-btn correctly reports 'No premium found' for unknown email, and PaymentSuccess page renders Processing/Success/Failed states with working 'Go Back' navigation.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 500 for invalid/unknown session_id; would be cleaner to return 404. Frontend polls 10x (~20s) on 500 before settling on 'Payment Failed' which works but is slow.

passed_tests: POST /api/payments/create-checkout returns checkout_url + session_id (with and without email)
GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} returns status & payment_status for valid session
POST /api/payments/check-premium returns is_premium=false for unknown email
Crown button (premium-btn) opens Unlock Premium modal
restore-btn shows 'No premium found' info toast for unknown email
checkout-btn redirects user to Stripe Checkout (https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_...)
'Go Back' button on Payment Failed navigates to /
/payment-success?session_id=... renders 'Processing Payment' initial state and polls status
action_items: (Optional, minor) Return HTTP 404 instead of 500 in GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} when Stripe lookup fails so frontend can fail-fast rather than polling for ~20s.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is ~1440 lines — should be split into smaller modules (PaymentModal, ConversationMode, Phrasebook, hooks) for maintainability (>700 line threshold).

PaymentSuccess.js polling loop uses [sessionId, attempts] in useEffect deps; this works but re-creates the closure on each attempt — acceptable, but could be simplified with a single interval + cleanup.
create_checkout endpoint catches all exceptions and returns 500 with raw exception detail; consider mapping Stripe errors to 4xx where appropriate and avoid leaking internal error messages.
test_credentials: Stripe test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 (not exercised — Stripe-hosted page out of scope for headless test)
seed_data_creation: Test data created with TEST_ prefix in payment_transactions collection (pending sessions). Not cleaned up — Stripe test sessions auto-expire.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend payment endpoints (create-checkout, status, check-premium) and frontend payment flow are fully functional. Stripe checkout redirect confirmed working. PaymentSuccess routing + Go Back navigation works. Only minor improvement: backend should return 404 not 500 for invalid session_ids.
